failure_scope: Five automatic bilingual cases did not settle; their minutes may already be complete. Last validation diagnostics do not expose a subsequent incomplete stream. No claim of a final streaming failure cause without preserved partial response.
manual_review: Source Chinese institutions and mixed professor names retained literally, rather than inferred as Denver/Dundee identities without a verified alias.
ALICE/LICE and UN VIDEO CARD/ENVY A CARD remain distinct raw source spellings; no guessed NVIDIA/OmaScribe identity.
Original dates, negative approval, money and source revisions/citations reviewed in the focused set.
Mixed-script LICE test boundary corrected from Unicode word-boundary to ASCII identifier boundary; old failed report retained.
Continuous presentation list labels removed before factual validation; prices, decimals and nonsequential content retained.
